 The Tampa Bay Lightning (8-3-1) and Nashville Predators (4-4-5) will meet in the NHL tonight. Puck drop is set for 2:00 p.m. EDT at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville, Tenn. The game will broadcast live on ESPN+.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Lightning are favored at -176 on the moneyline, with the Predators +142 to pull off the upset. The over/under is set at 6.5 (+110o / -134u).
 Let's get into our Lightning vs. Predators predictions and NHL picks .
 Lightning vs. Predators Prediction
 Pick: Lightning -1.5 (+140) 
 Our Tampa Bay vs. Nashville best bet is on Tampa Bay to cover the spread, with the best odds currently available at FanDuel. For all of your NHL bets, be sure to find the best lines by using our live NHL odds page and be sure to download the Action Network app for more picks and analysis.
 Lightning vs Predators Odds
 Lightning vs. Predators puck line: Lightning -1.5 (+140), Predators +1.5 (-172)
 Lightning vs. Predators over/under: 6.5 (+110o / -134u)
 Lightning vs. Predators moneyline: Lightning -176, Predators +146
 Lightning vs. Predators best bet: Lightning -1.5 (+140)
 The "Early Road Puckline" system in NHL spread is based on the idea that early season road favorites often struggle to separate themselves by margin even when they win games.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In the first fifteen games of the season teams are still building chemistry, rotations are not fully set, and travel can create inconsistencies in performance. When these favorites are listed as the visitor or on neutral ice the public tends to overestimate their ability to dominate, yet the outcomes often remain tighter than expected.
 By focusing on spread ranges that capture moderate market confidence, the system identifies value in fading early season road favorites on the puckline since the grind of travel and lack of midseason rhythm reduce their likelihood of covering larger margins.
 The Lightning enter listed at -1.5 on the puck line against the Predators . The market prices the road favorite with big plus-money upside.
 Tampa Bay looks like a juggernaut right now. The Lightning hold an 8-3-1 record and average 3.67 goals per game. Nikita Kucherov , Brandon Hagel , and Jake Guentzel torch opponents every time they step on the ice.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Nashville, on the other hand, cannot find the back of the net. The Predators sit at 4-4-5 and rank near the bottom of the NHL with just 2.85 goals per game. Even with Juuse Saros between the pipes, Nashville bleeds chances when forced to play from behind.
 Once the Lightning grab a lead, the Predators must pull its goalie late. That spells trouble against Tampa Bay's lethal top line, which feasts on empty nets.
 Back the better squad.
 Best Bet: Lightning -1.5 (+140)
